title: Pig eating a snack
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <!-- pig body -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='66' rx='30' ry='22' fill='#f7a8c4'/>
  <!-- body shading -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='70' rx='24' ry='15' fill='#f39ab8'/>
  <!-- head -->
  <circle cx='50' cy='40' r='21' fill='#fbb6ce'/>
  <!-- ears -->
  <path d='M33 26 L27 10 L44 20 Z' fill='#f39ab8'/>
  <path d='M67 26 L73 10 L56 20 Z' fill='#f39ab8'/>
  <path d='M34 24 L31 15 L42 21 Z' fill='#f7c9da'/>
  <path d='M66 24 L69 15 L58 21 Z' fill='#f7c9da'/>
  <!-- eyes -->
  <circle cx='41' cy='36' r='4.5' fill='#3a2c46'/>
  <circle cx='59' cy='36' r='4.5' fill='#3a2c46'/>
  <circle cx='42.5' cy='34.5' r='1.6' fill='#ffffff'/>
  <circle cx='60.5' cy='34.5' r='1.6' fill='#ffffff'/>
  <!-- snout -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='48' rx='11' ry='8' fill='#f07aa3'/>
  <ellipse cx='46' cy='48' rx='2' ry='3' fill='#3a2c46'/>
  <ellipse cx='54' cy='48' rx='2' ry='3' fill='#3a2c46'/>
  <!-- snack: cookie held to snout -->
  <circle cx='64' cy='58' r='7' fill='#d9a05b'/>
  <circle cx='61' cy='55' r='1.4' fill='#6b4a2b'/>
  <circle cx='67' cy='56' r='1.4' fill='#6b4a2b'/>
  <circle cx='64' cy='61' r='1.4' fill='#6b4a2b'/>
  <circle cx='68' cy='61' r='1.2' fill='#6b4a2b'/>
  <!-- front legs -->
  <rect x='33' y='80' width='10' height='12' rx='5' fill='#fbb6ce'/>
  <rect x='57' y='80' width='10' height='12' rx='5' fill='#fbb6ce'/>
  <!-- hooves -->
  <rect x='33' y='88' width='10' height='5' rx='2.5' fill='#e06f95'/>
  <rect x='57' y='88' width='10' height='5' rx='2.5' fill='#e06f95'/>
  <!-- curly tail -->
  <path d='M80 62 q8 -2 6 6 q-2 6 -8 3' fill='none' stroke='#e06f95' stroke-width='3' stroke-linecap='round'/>
</svg>
